_comment: The Stagenet 'Ledger RC3 compatible' stack. These move TOGETHER — bumping one
alone is unsupported. Source: Midnight Q2 2026 Beta Delivery Document.
Do NOT copy versions out of the midnight-context snapshot: that snapshot tracks
the PREVIEW line (node 1.0.0, indexer 4.3.2, ledger 8.x) and is a reference for
API shape only. Stagenet is a separate, newer line.

notes.zkirV3: --feature-zkir-v3 is a COMPILER flag. Contracts built with it must run against the _experimental proof-server build — the plain build will not verify them.
notes.indexerApi: GraphQL path is /api/v4/graphql on Stagenet. It is version-scoped and moves with the indexer image; a mismatch fails as an opaque 404.

dockerTags._comment: Verified present on Docker Hub (midnightntwrk/*) on 2026-08-13. Live in ops/localnet/env/rc3.env.
dockerTags.indexerTagWarning: There is no plain '4.4.0-pre-alpha.16' tag. The published image carries the build suffix above; shortening it gives 'manifest unknown'.

unresolved.compactLanguageVersion: Compiler 0.31.x maps to language 0.23.0; the 0.33.0-rc.2 release notes do not state its language version. Confirm with `compact compile --version` once the toolchain is installed.
unresolved.stagenetNetworkId: The NetworkId string Stagenet expects is not documented in the delivery note. Localnet is 'undeployed'. Set MRA_NETWORK_ID until confirmed.
unresolved.indexerUpgrade: indexer-standalone 4.4.0-rc.2 is published and is a clean tag, but Stagenet was tested on pre-alpha.16. Do not switch without checking node 2.0.0-rc.4 compatibility.
